name: Traxxas X-Maxx 8S
rights: Replica of the Traxxas X-Maxx 8S (77086-4) made with the permission the project owner stated on 2026-11-17 (docs/DECISIONS.md). Shape and proportions only: no Traxxas logos, decals or graphics are included.
frame: Model frame: +X right, +Y up, -Z forward; origin on the centre line at the chassis datum (the flat underside of the chassis tub). Physics FRD: +X forward, +Y right, +Z down from the same datum.

length.source: Traxxas 77086-4 specification as listed by retailers (rcsuperstore.com, recreationid.com): length 779 mm; one review gives 758 mm

width.source: Traxxas 77086-4 specification as listed by retailers: width 540 mm (outside of the tires)

height.source: Retailer listings of the 77086-4: overall height about 350 mm

wheelbase.source: Traxxas 77086-4 specification as listed by retailers: wheelbase 480 mm

ground_clearance.source: Traxxas 77086-4 specification as listed by retailers: ground clearance 102 mm (some list 107 mm)

mass_without_battery.source: Retailer listings of the 77086-4: 19.1 lb (8.66 kg) without battery

tire_diameter.source: Retailer listings of the 77086-4: 8.0 x 4.0 in tires (203 mm)

tire_width.source: Retailer listings of the 77086-4: 8.0 x 4.0 in tires (102 mm wide)

shock_length.source: Retailer listings of the 77086-4: shock length 187 mm (7.4 in)

motor_kv.source: Velineon 1200XL motor, replacement part rated 1275 Kv (marketed as 1200XL)

cells.source: VXL-8s ESC on two 4S LiPo packs (8S, 29.6 V nominal)

top_speed_claim.source: Traxxas claim on two 4S LiPos: 50+ mph (22.35 m/s); Big Squid RC measured 42 mph on stock gearing

battery_mass.source: two 4S 5000-6700 mAh hard-case LiPo packs, about 0.6 kg each

unsprung_mass_per_corner.source: tire and wheel (about 0.45 kg) plus hub carrier, half the arms, half the shock and the outer driveshaft

sprung_cg_above_datum.source: batteries and motor low in the tub (0.03-0.05 m), body shell and towers high (0.15-0.2 m)

sprung_gyration_factor.source: fraction of a uniform box's inertia: the mass is concentrated near the centre of the 0.62 x 0.40 x 0.22 m sprung envelope

sprung_envelope.source: chassis and body without wheels: length, width, height

wheel_inertia_tire.source: 0.45 kg tire and wheel at a 0.076 m radius of gyration (mass mostly in the tire)

motor_rotor_inertia.source: 56 mm class 4-pole rotor, about 0.25 kg at a 10 mm radius of gyration

arm_inner_offset.source: inner hinge pins from the centre line

wheel_center_rest_below_datum.source: free-length wheel centre below the tub, set so the static ride height gives the published 102 mm clearance

travel_bump.source: bump travel from the spring's free length

travel_droop.source: droop travel from the spring's free length

wheel_rate.source: about 23 mm static sag and a 3.3 Hz corner ride frequency

damping_ratio.source: oil shocks on a plush basher set-up

tire_slip_relaxation.source: estimate for a large soft tire

esc_current_limit.source: VXL-8s current limiting is not published; 250 A estimate

free_speed_margin.source: the claimed top speed taken as 95 % of the no-load ground speed

visual.body_side_profile: x (forward), y (up) from the datum, clockwise from the nose bottom; arches are cut around the wheels
